mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (user_id, body, rating) VALUES (#{userId}, #{body}, #{rating}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET body = EXCLUDED.body, rating = EXCLUDED.rating, status = 'PENDING', updated_at = now(), moderated_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT body, rating, status, updated_at FROM comments WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.id, u.display_name, u.job_role, u.level, c.body, c.rating, c.updated_at FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.status = 'APPROVED' AND u.banned_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT c.id, u.email, u.display_name, c.body, c.rating, c.status, c.updated_at FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET status = #{status}, moderated_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
